## Principal Product Manager

Location: Hybrid / Vancouver, WA (HQ): 3-4 days/week in-person Reports to: Chief Product Officer Job Type: Full-Time, Exempt

About Digs

Digs is an innovative startup building software that revolutionizes collaboration between builders and homeowners by leveraging artificial intelligence. We make organizing and sharing information intuitive, ultimately enhancing the customer experience.

Our small, dynamic team includes experienced entrepreneurs, leaders, and makers who are passionate about pushing boundaries and delivering world-class products. Want to know what drives us? Explore our Digs Principles.

What you'll do

This is a high-ownership Principal Product Manager role focused on expanding and scaling key product areas across the platform. You'll partner closely with our CPO, Engineering, and Design teams to increase product execution capacity and strategic depth.

You'll operate across both strategy and execution, owning meaningful product areas end-to-end while helping raise the overall bar for how we think, build, and ship at Digs.

You will:

- Own and scale core product areas end-to-end, from strategy through delivery
- Define and drive outcome-based roadmaps tied to customer and company impact
- Partner with Engineering and Design to ship high-impact product work
- Translate complex, real-world construction workflows into clear product direction
- Drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing needs and stakeholders
- Work closely with customers and internal partners (including Sales and GTM) to synthesize feedback into product direction and validation loops
- Define KPIs and use them to guide decisions, tradeoffs, and iteration
- Help evolve how Product operates as we scale (planning, discovery, execution)

Who you are

You're a principal product leader who thrives in early-stage environments where structure is still forming, but you bring clarity and rigor that help shape it.

You likely:

- Have 10+ years of product management or closely related experience in technical or product-facing roles
- Have shipped complex B2B or workflow-heavy software end-to-end with real customer impact
- Operate fluently across strategy and execution without relying on heavy process
- Are highly customer-driven and strong at turning messy, real-world inputs into clear product direction
- Are effective across engineering, design, GTM, and leadership teams
- Are strong at prioritization and making high-quality tradeoffs under ambiguity
- Are comfortable with evolving direction and incomplete information
- Care deeply about outcomes, ownership, and building durable systems over features

Bonus if you have

- Experience in construction, real estate, or other operationally comp

# A few new faces are joining the Digs team, and we couldn’t be more excited 🎉 | Digs · LinkedIn · 2026-08-04

**Digs**: Digs is a collaborative software for homebuilding that eliminates client and team frustration by managing communication, documents, and decisions all in one place. It offers pre-construction, design, and warranty management solutions for custom builders, production builders, remodelers, and homeowners. Digs has 30-40 employees (+30% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $1M-$10M range, founded in 2022. Headquartered in Vancouver, Washington, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and United Kingdom. Has $19M in total funding, with 2 prior funding rounds.

---

A few new faces are joining the Digs team, and we couldn’t be more excited 🎉

[Robert Gebhardt](https://linkedin.com/in/robert-gebhardt-5a934a2) - Staff Software Engineer
Rob joins Digs with a strong background in building and scaling software at companies like Tripalink, OpenGov, and Jama Software. He’s spent his career helping teams tackle complex technical challenges and build products that support growing organizations. We’re excited to have his engineering leadership and builder mindset on the team.

[Todd Lemoine](https://linkedin.com/in/toddlemoine) - Senior Software Engineer
Todd joins us with years of experience building enterprise software across OpenGov, Streem, Jama Software, Jive, and Webtrends. From modernizing platforms to shipping impactful product experiences, Todd brings a thoughtful approach to solving tough engineering problems. We’re thrilled to have his technical expertise and curiosity at Digs.

[Peter Mooney](https://linkedin.com/in/petermooney513) - Senior Software Engineer
Peter joins us from Socratic and is another Jama alum joining the Digs team. His experience spans building AI-powered products, navigating multiple product pivots, and helping teams build quality software through thoughtful engineering practices. We’re stoked to have his technical depth and product-minded approach on the team.

John (J.R.) Carlson - Principal Product Manager
J.R. brings a unique combination of product leadership, AI innovation, and construction industry experience. Most recently, he built AI solutions for construction companies, and before that led product initiatives at Lennar and The Home Depot focused on builders and Pro customers. We’re excited to have his builder empathy, AI-first mindset, and product expertise as we continue shaping the future of construction technology.

We’re lucky to have this group of builders, problem solvers, and product thinkers joining Digs 👏

Welcome to the team, Rob, Todd, Peter, and J.R.!

![A few new faces are joining the Digs team, and we couldn’t be more excited 🎉 | Digs image](https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/v2/D5622AQF9eJsCTq1cww/feedshare-shrink_1280/B56Z_N5F0DKoAM-/0/1785865723435?e=2147483647&v=beta&t=SKg3fJ6CjTb5Yz8X1A12lqMGwGxgpuPlmXJH6uGiJhQ)
